name: build.rs tokens generation + src/palette.rs

test_list.description: Every role of polaris_ui_model::tokens::ROLES and palette::WELCOME_ROLES appears in the generated tokens.slint with exactly its hex value.
No welcome-only role reuses a name of the shared ROLES table, and names are unique.
The hand-written ui/*.slint files contain no '#RGB..' colour literal; colours come from the Tokens global.
tokens.slint states radius RADIUS_PX px and speed SPEED_MS ms, and one font property per FONTS entry.

output_description: A Slint `export global Tokens` with one out property per role, radius, speed and font families.
